subject: Meeting Rescheduling Request
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. Due to unforeseen circumstances, I need to request a rescheduling of our upcoming team meeting scheduled for this Friday. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and I appreciate your understanding. Please let me know your availability for next week so we can find a suitable alternative time slot. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
